lines.5: 「Do not stare at me so much.」
lines.7: 「...I suppose you simply look dear to me.」
lines.8: 「Th-that line is a hundred times more embarrassing!」
lines.12: 「I would like to keep talking... but I am growing sleepy.」
lines.13: 「It's not like today is our last chance.」
lines.14: 「Save whatever you wanted to say for tomorrow or the day after.」
lines.16: 「From now on, I am going to sleep here every night.」
lines.18: 「My feet get cold in winter, so I'd like you to warm them.」
lines.20: 「That sounds miserable. When winter comes, I will entwine my legs with yours and warm you.」
lines.22: There was something in her gaze that felt closer to familial affection than romance.
lines.26: Only the sound of the air conditioner echoed through the room.
lines.28: 「I feel as though someone is watching me.」
lines.30: 「It is embarrassing. You should go to sleep too.」
lines.38: Sorry, Otome. I didn't mean to lie, but I couldn't fall asleep right away.
lines.39: If I watched her sleeping face, I would eventually drift off on my own.
